breakdown.description: The centroid point load is replaced by a uniform traction over the hypotenuse
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly specified distributing the centroid force as a uniform traction over the hypotenuse. The generated specification correctly uses dolfin PointSource acting on the y-displacement component at point (0.5, 0.25), which matches the ground truth's instruction to 'Represent each concentrated load with PointSource on the appropriate displacement component instead of smearing it over an edge.' The generated spec explicitly states 'Apply a concentrated vertical load of magnitude -5000 N at point (0.5, 0.25) using dolfin PointSource acting on the y-displacement component only,' resolving the inconsistency.
